notes: Takes only 10 to 12 students a year. Students from St. Louis Public Schools and under-resourced schools are strongly encouraged to apply. Work is in person in the lab. The page banner says 2027 applications are open, though a lower section still reads as if they open Nov 2, 2026.
name: Summer Focus (Young Scientist Program)
org: Washington University in St. Louis, Young Scientist Program
what_you_do: Work in a WashU lab on a biomedical research project with a mentor and a tutor. You also take classes on science communication and college prep. You speak at a closing symposium.
who_can_apply: Rising seniors (finished 11th grade) from any high school in Missouri or Illinois in the Greater St. Louis area. You do not need research experience. Missouri and Illinois residents only.
duration: 8 weeks (June 7 to July 30, 2027), with orientation June 2 to 4, 2027
deadline_text: 2027 applications are open. Due Jan 25, 2027. Recommendation letters due Feb 1, 2027.
how_to_apply: Online application with five short answers and two essays. Two recommendation letters, one from a math or science teacher.
